definition: Stable unique observation identifier
cleaning_rule: Never changed after assignment
provenance_rule: Links every later transformation back to one observation
duplicate_rule: Never used to infer duplicate identity

definition: Human-approved identifier linking listings that may represent one underlying product family
cleaning_rule: Assign only after duplicate review; unresolved families remain provisional
duplicate_rule: Merge only after human review of operator/title/duration/meeting/inclusions/options

definition: Marketplace, destination channel, or direct source where the listing was observed
cleaning_rule: Standardize source code without changing provenance
lawful_use_note: Use public pages under applicable terms

definition: Public URL used for the observation
cleaning_rule: Preserve exact URL; prefer product-detail page
missing_value_rule: Never blank unless page access failure is separately logged
provenance_rule: Record exact public location and collection date
lawful_use_note: No URL shortening; respect platform terms

definition: Calendar date on which the public observation was collected
cleaning_rule: ISO date only
provenance_rule: Ties time-sensitive facts to observation date

definition: Listing title exactly as publicly displayed at collection
cleaning_rule: Do not rewrite or normalize this field
missing_value_rule: Use NOT_DISPLAYED only if a title is genuinely absent
duplicate_rule: Useful for duplicate candidates but never sufficient alone
example: Anne Frank: Small-Group Walking Tour & Local Guide

definition: Primary mutually exclusive product category used for structured comparison
cleaning_rule: Apply taxonomy in collection protocol

definition: More specific product-form descriptor below primary category
cleaning_rule: Use concise observable product form
missing_value_rule: NOT_DISPLAYED if source does not permit classification

definition: Whether the product competes directly for the defined visitor job or acts as a substitute
cleaning_rule: Classify from visitor job, not category similarity alone
missing_value_rule: UNRESOLVED when visitor-job overlap is unclear

definition: Currency code displayed for the observed price
cleaning_rule: Use uppercase ISO code
price_rule: Never convert in this field

definition: Price text exactly as displayed, including crossed-out/promotional context where captured
cleaning_rule: Do not overwrite source formatting
provenance_rule: Time-sensitive observation tied to URL/date/service scenario
price_rule: Preserve all displayed price context

definition: Numeric interpretation of the observed payable price under the recorded option
cleaning_rule: Parse only an unambiguous payable price; do not infer
price_rule: Never mix group and person bases

definition: Unit to which cleaned_price applies
cleaning_rule: Classify explicit page basis
price_rule: Rows with different bases are not pooled

definition: Publicly displayed product duration standardized for analysis
cleaning_rule: Convert hours to minutes; preserve ranges as min-max
price_rule: Do not infer from itinerary

definition: Observed participation model
cleaning_rule: Use only explicit group-format evidence
price_rule: Impacts price comparability

definition: Language availability explicitly displayed for the observed product/option
cleaning_rule: Record only displayed languages for observed option
missing_value_rule: NOT_DISPLAYED is not equivalent to one language

definition: Maximum scale used by the public rating system
cleaning_rule: Numeric scale only
price_rule: Never convert ratings to demand

definition: Public aggregate rating displayed at observation
cleaning_rule: Preserve displayed aggregate
price_rule: Do not infer quality or bookings

definition: Public review-count aggregate displayed at observation
cleaning_rule: Remove thousands separators only
price_rule: Never treat as bookings

definition: Concise analyst coding of the product promise/positioning visible in the listing
cleaning_rule: Summarize observable wording only

definition: Observable features that may distinguish the listing
cleaning_rule: Code only disclosed features
missing_value_rule: Blank if not disclosed; absence is not non-offer

definition: Free-text note describing possible cross-platform or option duplication
cleaning_rule: Describe uncertainty; do not merge here
missing_value_rule: Blank means no note, not confirmed uniqueness

definition: Indicates whether one or more expected analytical fields are unavailable/undisclosed
cleaning_rule: true when expected comparison fields are missing
provenance_rule: Do not convert missing to zero/no

definition: Evidence class under Article 01 hierarchy
cleaning_rule: Assign based on evidence origin

definition: Analyst confidence in correctness/interpretability of the record
cleaning_rule: Use rule in collection protocol

definition: Legacy dataset status retained for backward compatibility
cleaning_rule: Keep existing pilot rows as PILOT; new production rows use FULL after capture
provenance_rule: Do not use as readiness stage; use collection_stage

definition: Organization/operator responsible for the page or listing when distinguishable from source platform
cleaning_rule: Preserve published organization name

definition: Most specific publicly accessible product-detail URL for the listing
cleaning_rule: Prefer canonical detail URL over category/search page
missing_value_rule: Blank only if detail URL unavailable

definition: Publicly disclosed operating/provider company for the underlying experience
cleaning_rule: Record only when publicly disclosed
missing_value_rule: NOT_DISPLAYED if the platform does not disclose it
provenance_rule: Evidence must be page/public operator source
duplicate_rule: Strong duplicate key but not alone

definition: Public SKU/product/reference ID when displayed in URL/page/metadata
cleaning_rule: Preserve identifier exactly

definition: Timestamp when the price/availability observation was made
cleaning_rule: Use Amsterdam-local or offset-aware timestamp consistently
missing_value_rule: Blank only for legacy pilot rows

definition: Future travel/service date selected for comparable price observation
cleaning_rule: Use common protocol date/window
missing_value_rule: Blank for legacy pilot or non-bookable pages
price_rule: Prices across different service dates are not pooled

definition: Standard party used when observing price and availability
allowed_values: 1_adult_standard unless product requires another documented basis
cleaning_rule: Use same scenario unless product cannot support it
price_rule: Do not compare incompatible party bases

definition: Specific bookable option/ticket/tour variant used for the observation
cleaning_rule: Record option without assuming cheapest is equivalent
price_rule: Option differences may block duplicate/price comparison

definition: Context needed to interpret the observed public values, including date, party, option, promo, availability or page limitations
cleaning_rule: Concise factual notes only
example: Price shown after selecting 1 adult on common service date

definition: Whether the observed price presentation appears promotional
cleaning_rule: YES only when a discount/reference price is visibly presented
missing_value_rule: UNREVIEWED for legacy pilot until checked
price_rule: Promotional and non-promotional values may require separate treatment

definition: Displayed crossed-out/reference price when a promotion is shown
unit_or_format: verbatim or numeric with currency context
cleaning_rule: Preserve source value; do not infer savings
missing_value_rule: Blank if no displayed reference price
provenance_rule: Tie to original_price and promo flag
price_rule: Not used as payable price

definition: Currency used only for approved cross-currency analytical comparison
required_stage: Required only when normalization is approved
cleaning_rule: Populate only with documented FX rule
price_rule: Never overwrite display_currency

definition: Comparable numeric price converted to normalized_currency under documented rules
required_stage: Required only for eligible price-analysis rows
cleaning_rule: Compute from cleaned_price only after basis/date compatibility
provenance_rule: Transformation note and FX provenance required
price_rule: Exclude bundles/group bases unless analyzed separately

definition: Exchange rate used to create normalized_price
cleaning_rule: Use one documented reference source/date for analysis batch
provenance_rule: Record external FX source in transformation note or protocol

definition: Reference date of the FX rate used for normalization
cleaning_rule: Use documented common date

definition: Concise observable itinerary/route or major stops as publicly disclosed
cleaning_rule: Do not add undisclosed stops
price_rule: Strong duplicate/supporting evidence

definition: Publicly disclosed inclusions relevant to comparison and duplicate review
cleaning_rule: Record only explicit inclusions
price_rule: Strong duplicate/supporting evidence

definition: Publicly disclosed meeting/start location at useful non-sensitive granularity
cleaning_rule: Preserve public commercial meeting information; avoid collecting personal/private data

definition: Public cancellation/refund policy applicable to observed option
cleaning_rule: Record policy as displayed; do not provide legal interpretation

definition: Temporary candidate-cluster ID used while investigating possible duplicate listings
cleaning_rule: Candidate only; never implies merge
duplicate_rule: Human decision required before product-family merge

definition: Human review state for duplicate identity
cleaning_rule: Update only through documented duplicate review
provenance_rule: Product family cannot be treated final when REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNRESOLVED

definition: Field/record-level note explaining non-trivial cleaning, conversion or analytical transformation
cleaning_rule: State what changed and why; never erase original values
price_rule: Required for FX and special price handling

definition: Operational lifecycle stage for the observation
cleaning_rule: Advance only when stage QA passes
price_rule: ANALYSIS_READY also requires compatible price treatment when used

definition: Analyst/reviewer identifier or role that approved the current stage
cleaning_rule: Use role/initials under team governance
missing_value_rule: Blank for legacy pilot if not recorded

definition: Date of most recent human QA review
cleaning_rule: ISO date
missing_value_rule: Blank only for unreviewed RAW rows

definition: Phase 2D identity-resolution outcome for the sampled dataset.
cleaning_rule: Do not infer sameness from title similarity alone.
missing_value_rule: Never blank for FULL after Phase 2D.
provenance_rule: Derived from human-style evidence review of sampled listings.
duplicate_rule: Must align with duplicate_review_status and product_family_id.
confidence_rule: High only where operator/product evidence aligns; otherwise distinct within sampled dataset.
lawful_use_note: Uses public commercial product evidence only.
reviewer_requirement: Independent confirmation required for every same-family merge before freeze.

definition: Phase 2D price-comparability gate status.
cleaning_rule: Never convert a display price into a comparable analytical price until participant/date/basis checks pass.
provenance_rule: Derived from captured price basis/value and protocol controls.
price_rule: Common service date and participant scenario required before cross-product price analysis.
confidence_rule: Status reflects QA gate, not market certainty.
lawful_use_note: Public displayed pricing only; no access-control bypass.
reviewer_requirement: Independent review of normalized-price rule before freeze.

definition: Whether the observed price is currently eligible for cross-product statistical analysis.
source_or_method: Derived from price_qa_status plus participant/date/basis/currency checks
cleaning_rule: Default false until all CP07–CP13 controls pass.
missing_value_rule: Use false until all price gates pass.
price_rule: True only for prices valid for the defined comparison batch.
confidence_rule: Deterministic gate from documented price controls.
reviewer_requirement: Second review required for FX-normalized rule.

definition: Independent second-review state required by CP22.
cleaning_rule: Do not mark COMPLETE from the same reconciliation pass.
confidence_rule: Complete only when reviewer/date/notes are recorded.
reviewer_requirement: At least 20% of FULL rows plus every same-family merge.

definition: Plain-language explanation of why a row is or is not analysis-ready.
cleaning_rule: State specific blockers; do not imply evidence not collected.
missing_value_rule: Required when collection_stage is not ANALYSIS_READY.
example: Blocked: common-date price and independent second review pending.
confidence_rule: Must be consistent with the row QA fields.

definition: Date of Phase 2E public-price verification attempt
cleaning_rule: Record actual recheck date
missing_value_rule: Never blank for FULL after Phase 2E
provenance_rule: Links price QA to freeze pass

definition: Common service-date window used for price comparability
cleaning_rule: Use one batch window for date-dependent products
missing_value_rule: Never blank for FULL after Phase 2E
price_rule: Date-independent digital products may use explicit exception

definition: Fresh source-currency price captured in Phase 2E without overwriting the original observation
cleaning_rule: Numeric price only; preserve original_price and cleaned_price
price_rule: Must match rechecked_price_basis

definition: Currency of rechecked_source_price
cleaning_rule: Preserve source currency
price_rule: Never infer currency

definition: Analytical basis of the Phase 2E price recheck
cleaning_rule: Only eligible basis values may feed normalized_price
missing_value_rule: Blank when no rechecked numeric price
price_rule: Do not pool incompatible bases

definition: Specific public URL used for Phase 2E price/identity recheck
cleaning_rule: Prefer product detail URL

definition: Named reference source used for currency normalization
cleaning_rule: Use one documented batch source/date
price_rule: ECB rates quoted currency units per EUR; stored fx_rate is EUR per source currency
